runs.summary: Rerun with nothing changed, 2024 comes out as it did: Trump wins, 312–226. The closest state was Wisconsin, which went to Trump by 0.9 points. Every one of my 100 reruns reproduces it exactly.
howIGotThis: The numbers: the 2020 census counts carried forward to 2024 and certified returns; every draw reproduces 2024 exactly before the change.
How sure: I reran it 100 times with different population and parameter draws.

everyone.summary: 113.8 million more adults vote. Georgia, Wisconsin flip, but Trump still wins, 286–252. The closest call is North Carolina, which holds for Trump by 0.2 points. Harris wins in 35 of 100 draws.
